Notes:
- You don't need your passport details, date of birth or home address on this form. The address boxes (B05, B15, B19, B24) are for the child and his parents, so I've left them for your sister.
- Your sister may want to sign or check the form herself as the parent. The form has no signature line, so ask the preschool whether they need a parent's signature or a note from her saying you're applying for her.
